voice.summary: Sounds like a product demo at speed: short, clipped and confident, in the register of a dark-mode launch page. It talks about building rather than tooling.
dos: Use short verbs like design, build and ship
Keep headlines to two or three words
donts: No jargon like leverage or empower

taglines: Design at the speed of thought
Your next site, drafted in seconds
